# What a pr-review-main review reads from main: the lane's criteria, the
# standards, and the prompt, scripts and workflow that run it. Each line is
# `<how> <path on main> [<path under the data directory>]`; {skill} is the
# lane's skill. `copy` must exist, `copy-if-present` may be absent, and `read`
# runs in place from the main checkout. The copy steps copy these; the trigger
# job counts a verdict only when none of them differs from main's tip.
copy plugins/review/skills/{skill} review/skills/{skill}
copy plugins/review/reference review/reference
copy REVIEW.md standards/REVIEW.md
copy docs/standards standards/standards
copy-if-present docs/review standards/review
copy-if-present .claude/rules standards/rules
read .github/scripts/pr-review-main
read .github/workflows/pr-review-main.yml
